items.title: An r-partite ordered hypergraph matching realising prescribed clique-size bounds via a monotone point set
items.author: Lisa Sauermann, Dmitrii Zakharov
items.work: A Sharp Ramsey Theorem for Ordered Hypergraph Matchings
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the construction lemma that turns a monotone point set into an ordered hypergraph matching with prescribed clique-size bounds (author lemma at source lines 556-560, label obs-construction-partite). The proof (source lines 564-571) is the author's own, headed Proof of Lemma obs-construction-partite, and it is a clean correspondence argument: the patterns of the finest partition are parameterised by the monotone functions tau, the author's multi-dimensional Erdos-Szekeres theorem provides a point set with distinct coordinates whose tau-monotone sequences are bounded by the prescribed integers, and the coordinates of each point produce the edges of the matching, so that a P-clique corresponds precisely to a monotone sequence and the bounds transfer (proof lines 565-571). The lemma is the building block that the paper's lower-bound theorem iterates. H2.
